about: Shock Gauge daily review, run of 2026-11-24 08:23 JST (2026-11-23T23:23Z). Synthetic Stock News API rows modelled on that morning: the newest page of each lane holds only opinion pieces (all withheld as not-publishable), while the day's real downside stories sit 6 to 26 hours back, beyond the single page the job used to read. minutesBefore counts back from runAt.

stories.title: Nvidia Stock Falls After Earnings: Is It Time to Buy the Dip?
stories.text: Nvidia shares have pulled back from their highs. Here is what long-term investors should consider before adding to a position in the AI chip leader this week.

stories.title: 3 AI Stocks to Buy as Chip Shares Drop
stories.text: Chip stocks have cooled off, which could create an opening. These three artificial intelligence names look attractive for investors with a long time horizon.

stories.title: Should You Worry About the Stock Market Sell-Off?
stories.text: Market pullbacks are a normal part of investing. Here is how to think about volatility, diversification and your long-term plan when stocks wobble.

stories.title: Why Micron Stock Could Soar Despite Risks
stories.text: Micron faces familiar cyclical risks, but demand for high-bandwidth memory from AI data centers could keep growing for years, according to this contributor.

stories.title: Wall Street sell-off: what to watch this week
stories.text: Investors head into a holiday-shortened week with several economic reports on the calendar. Here are the events that could move markets in the days ahead.

stories.title: Nvidia shares fall 3% after report of tighter China export curbs
stories.text: Nvidia shares fell 3% on Monday after a report said U.S. officials were preparing tighter export curbs on advanced AI chips sold to China, a market that accounts for a large share of the company's data center sales.

stories.title: ASML shares under pressure after Dutch export update
stories.text: ASML shares traded lower after the Dutch government published updated export licensing rules covering additional chipmaking tools, which the company said would apply to some shipments to China.

stories.title: AMD stock slides 4% after analyst downgrade on weaker data center outlook
stories.text: AMD shares slid 4% after an analyst downgraded the stock to neutral, citing slower data center GPU orders and a weaker outlook for the first half of next year.

stories.title: Nasdaq futures drop as Treasury yields jump on inflation worries
stories.text: Nasdaq futures fell as the 10-year Treasury yield climbed after hotter-than-expected inflation data, putting pressure on technology stocks that are sensitive to higher interest rates.

stories.title: Micron cuts production forecast as memory chip prices weaken
stories.text: Micron lowered its production forecast for the current quarter, saying contract prices for some memory chips weakened more than expected as customers worked through inventory.

stories.title: Broadcom shares slide after customer delays AI chip orders
stories.text: Broadcom shares slid after a large cloud customer was reported to have delayed orders for custom AI accelerators into next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

stories.title: TSMC halts shipments to a Chinese customer after export probe
stories.text: TSMC halted shipments to a Chinese chip designer after U.S. authorities opened a probe into whether its chips reached a restricted company, the company said in a statement.
